title.narrative: IOM Damascus: Creating conditions for return and resilience in Syria
IOM Damaskus: Återvändande och återintegrering i Syrien

description.narrative:
Overarching objective: To enhance the sustainable (re)integration of displaced populations in Syria by improving conditions for dignified, voluntary and safe access to durable solutions to displacement, fostering long-term stability and resilience.
Outcome 1: Humanitarian and development partners use available data on mobility and needs of populations and communities inside Syria and the conditions in areas of return to inform decisions on dignified, voluntary and safe durable solutions.
Outcome 2: Progress towards sustainable return and reintegration of displacement-affected populations is strengthened through coordinated area-based interventions and multi-sectoral service provision that facilitate pathways towards durable solutions.

Stöd till IOM för att skapa förutsättningar för hållbar återintegrering av tvångsfördrivna personer i Syrien. Data insamling och områdesbaserat stöd inkl., juridiskt och psykosocialt stöd, bosatdsrehabilitering och småskaliga infrastrukturprojekt.

Support to IOM for creating a pathway for sustainable reintegration of displaced people in Syria.
The proposed intervention has the overarching objective to enhance the sustainable (re)integration of displaced populations in Syria by improving the conditions for dignified, voluntary, and safe access to durable solutions to displacement, fostering long¬term stability and resilience. The proposal aims to reach this objective by delivering two mutually reinforcing outcomes: ¬ Humanitarian and development partners use available data on mobility and needs of populations and communities inside Syria and the conditions in areas of return to inform decisions on dignified, voluntary, and safe durable solutions to displacement. ¬ Progress toward sustainable return and reintegration of displacement¬affected populations is strengthened through coordinated area-based interventions and multi¬sectoral service provision that facilitate pathways toward durable solutions.
